title_original: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC
title_en: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 on machinery (Machinery Regulation)
notes: New machinery law; essential requirements for autonomous mobile machinery, self-evolving (ML) safety functions, cybersecurity; high-risk list in Annex I; applies from 20 Jan 2027.

title_original: Directive 2006/42/EC on machinery
title_en: Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC
notes: CE-marking safety law covering industrial and service robots (harmonised standards EN ISO 10218, EN ISO 13482); repealed by Reg 2023/1230 with effect from 20 Jan 2027.

title_original: Proposal for a Regulation on machinery products COM(2021) 202
title_en: Proposal for a Regulation on machinery products (COM(2021) 202)
notes: Commission proposal that became Reg 2023/1230; introduced AI/self-evolving machinery, autonomous mobile machinery and cybersecurity requirements.

title_original: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on the harmonised standards for machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC
title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 on harmonised standards for machinery
notes: OJ listing of harmonised standards giving presumption of conformity under the Machinery Directive, incl. EN ISO 10218 (industrial robots) and EN ISO 13482 (personal care robots); amended repeatedly.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
notes: EU-wide drone operating rules: open/specific/certified categories, operator registration, SORA; amended by 2020/639, 2020/746, 2021/1166, 2022/425.

title_original: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and third-country operators
notes: Product requirements, CE class marks (C0-C6), remote ID and conformity assessment for drones; amended by 2020/1058 (new classes) and 2024/1108.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664 on a regulatory framework for the U-space
title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664 on a regulatory framework for the U-space
notes: Creates U-space airspace and U-space service providers (network ID, geo-awareness, flight authorisation, traffic information) for drone traffic management; applicable from 26 Jan 2023.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/665 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2017/373 as regards U-space
title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/665 amending Regulation 2017/373 as regards U-space airspace
notes: Requirements for ATM/ANS providers and network functions in U-space airspace designated in controlled airspace; companion act to Reg 2021/664.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/666 amending Regulation (EU) No 923/2012 as regards requirements for manned aviation operating in U-space airspace
title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/666 on manned aviation in U-space airspace
notes: Amends the Standardised European Rules of the Air so manned aircraft in U-space airspace are electronically conspicuous to drone operators; companion act to Reg 2021/664.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 on common rules in the field of civil aviation and establishing a European Union Aviation Safety Agency
title_en: Regulation (EU) 2018/1139 (EASA Basic Regulation)
notes: Brought all unmanned aircraft (regardless of mass) under EU competence (Section VII, Annex IX essential requirements for UAS); legal basis for Regs 2019/945, 2019/947 and U-space.

title_original: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1107 laying down detailed rules for the continuing airworthiness of certified unmanned aircraft systems
title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1107 on continuing airworthiness of certified unmanned aircraft systems
notes: First airworthiness framework for drones in the certified category (incl. eVTOL/large cargo UAS); part of the 2024 innovative air mobility package with Regs 2024/1108-1110.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/1109 laying down rules as regards competent authority requirements and administrative procedures for certified unmanned aircraft systems
title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/1109 on competent authority requirements for certified UAS
notes: Authority oversight and administrative procedures for certified-category drone operations; adopted together with Delegated Reg 2024/1108 and Implementing Reg 2024/1110 (initial airworthiness).

title_original: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2103 on harmonised standard for direct remote identification for unmanned aircraft drafted in support of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2103 on the harmonised standard for drone direct remote identification
notes: Publishes EN 4709-002 (direct remote ID) as harmonised standard giving presumption of conformity for drone remote identification under Reg 2019/945.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 on type-approval requirements for motor vehicles ... as regards their general safety (General Safety Regulation)
title_en: Regulation (EU) 2019/2144 General Safety Regulation
notes: Art. 11 sets requirements for automated and fully automated vehicles (driver availability monitoring, event data recorders, ODD, takeover) and empowers ADS type-approval rules.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 ... uniform procedures and technical specifications for the type-approval of the automated driving system (ADS) of fully automated vehicles
title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1426 on type-approval of the automated driving system (ADS) of fully automated vehicles
notes: World-first type-approval framework for SAE Level 4 vehicles (robotaxis, shuttles, hub-to-hub, valet parking): safety, HMI, DSSAD, cybersecurity, audit; amended by Reg (EU) 2026/481.

title_original: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Annexes I, II, IV and V to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards the technical requirements for vehicles produced in unlimited series, small series, EU small series and individual approval
title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Regulation 2018/858 annexes (incl. ADS requirements)
notes: Integrates the ADS requirements of Reg 2022/1426 into the type-approval annexes of Reg 2018/858 for unlimited and small series automated vehicles.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2018/858 on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers
title_en: Regulation (EU) 2018/858 vehicle type-approval framework
notes: Framework type-approval regulation; Art. 39 new-technology exemption route used for automated vehicles before harmonised ADS rules; annexes amended for ADS by Reg 2022/2236.

title_original: UN Regulation No 157 – Uniform provisions concerning the approval of vehicles with regards to Automated Lane Keeping Systems [2021/389]
title_en: UN Regulation No 157 on Automated Lane Keeping Systems (as applied in the EU)
notes: First binding Level 3 automation rule (ALKS up to 60 km/h, later 130 km/h), applied in the EU via Reg 2019/2144 Annex II; possible overlap with INT standards list.

title_original: Directive (EU) 2023/2661 amending Directive 2010/40/EU on the framework for the deployment of Intelligent Transport Systems
title_en: Directive (EU) 2023/2661 amending the ITS Directive (connected and automated mobility)
notes: Extends the ITS Directive to cooperative, connected and automated mobility, mandates data availability and interoperability supporting automated driving.

title_original: Directive (EU) 2024/2853 on liability for defective products and repealing Council Directive 85/374/EEC
title_en: Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853
notes: Strict liability extended to software and AI systems, updates, self-learning, cybersecurity defects; disclosure and presumptions of defect; applies to products placed on the market from 9 Dec 2026.

title_original: Council Directive 85/374/EEC on liability for defective products
title_en: Product Liability Directive 85/374/EEC
notes: Original strict product liability regime applicable to robots and vehicles as products; repealed by Directive 2024/2853 with effect from 9 Dec 2026.

title_original: Proposal for a Directive on adapting non-contractual civil liability rules to artificial intelligence (AI Liability Directive) COM(2022) 496
title_en: Proposal for an AI Liability Directive (COM(2022) 496)
notes: Proposed presumptions of causality and disclosure of evidence for damage caused by AI systems incl. robots/AVs; withdrawn by the Commission in 2025 (Work Programme).

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2023/988 on general product safety
title_en: General Product Safety Regulation (EU) 2023/988
notes: Safety net for consumer products incl. connected and AI-enabled consumer robots; risk assessment must consider cybersecurity, evolving/learning features; applies from 13 Dec 2024.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2025/2509 on the safety of toys and repealing Directive 2009/48/EC
title_en: Toy Safety Regulation (EU) 2025/2509
notes: New toy safety rules incl. digital product passport, cybersecurity, privacy and mental-health safeguards for connected/AI toys (robot toys); applies after a 54-month transition.

title_original: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys
title_en: Toy Safety Directive 2009/48/EC
notes: Essential safety requirements and CE marking for toys incl. robotic and electronic toys; to be repealed by Reg 2025/2509.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 on horizontal cybersecurity requirements for products with digital elements (Cyber Resilience Act)
title_en: Cyber Resilience Act (EU) 2024/2847
notes: Mandatory cybersecurity-by-design, vulnerability handling and reporting for connected hardware/software incl. robots and drones; main obligations apply from 11 Dec 2027.

title_original: Directive 2009/104/EC concerning the minimum safety and health requirements for the use of work equipment by workers at work
title_en: Work Equipment Directive 2009/104/EC
notes: Employer duties for selection, risk assessment, maintenance and training on work equipment, applied to industrial/collaborative robots and occupational exoskeletons in use (complements Machinery law).

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2017/745 on medical devices
title_en: Medical Devices Regulation (EU) 2017/745
notes: Conformity assessment, clinical evaluation and post-market surveillance for surgical robots, robotic exoskeletons and software-driven devices (Rule 11 software classification).

title_original: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 supplementing Directive 2014/53/EU with regard to the application of the essential requirements referred to in Article 3(3), points (d), (e) and (f)
title_en: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/30 (Radio Equipment Directive cybersecurity requirements)
notes: Activates RED cybersecurity, privacy and fraud-protection requirements for internet-connected radio equipment incl. connected toys, wearables and robots; applicable from 1 Aug 2025.

title_original: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 on harmonised rules on fair access to and use of data (Data Act)
title_en: Data Act (EU) 2023/2854
notes: User and third-party access rights to data generated by connected products (vehicles, industrial and domestic robots, drones); applies from 12 Sep 2025.

title_original: Proposal for a Regulation on the safety, resilience and sustainability of space activities in the Union (EU Space Act) COM(2025) 335
title_en: Proposal for an EU Space Act (COM(2025) 335)
notes: Proposed authorisation, safety (collision avoidance, autonomous manoeuvring), cybersecurity and resilience rules for spacecraft operators and in-orbit servicing.

title_original: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and (EU) 2018/1139 as regards the simplification of the implementation of harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Digital Omnibus on AI) COM(2025) 836
title_en: Digital Omnibus on AI proposal (COM(2025) 836)
notes: Defers high-risk AI obligations (incl. Annex I product-embedded AI in machinery, vehicles, drones, medical devices) pending standards; EP amendments adopted 26 Mar 2026; related to D1049 briefing.

title_original: A Drone Strategy 2.0 for a Smart and Sustainable Unmanned Aircraft Eco-System in Europe COM(2022) 652
title_en: EU Drone Strategy 2.0 (COM(2022) 652)
notes: 19 flagship actions for drone services, U-space, counter-drone, certification of innovative air mobility and civil-military synergies by 2030.

title_original: On the road to automated mobility: An EU strategy for mobility of the future COM(2018) 283
title_en: EU strategy on automated mobility (COM(2018) 283)
notes: EU strategy for connected and automated driving: type-approval exemption guidelines, liability, data, cybersecurity, ethics expert group; aims for driverless mobility by 2030.

title_original: A European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems, a milestone towards cooperative, connected and automated mobility COM(2016) 766
title_en: European strategy on Cooperative ITS (COM(2016) 766)
notes: Strategy for deployment of C-ITS from 2019 as a step towards connected and automated driving; security, data protection and interoperability principles.

title_original: Report on the safety and liability implications of Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things and robotics COM(2020) 64
title_en: Commission report on safety and liability implications of AI, IoT and robotics (COM(2020) 64)
notes: Accompanied the AI White Paper; identified gaps in EU product safety and liability law for robots/AI (autonomy, opacity, connectivity) leading to Machinery Reg, GPSR, PLD revisions.

title_original: AI Continent Action Plan COM(2025) 165
title_en: AI Continent Action Plan (COM(2025) 165)
notes: Five-pillar plan (AI factories, data, sector adoption incl. robotics, skills, simplification) announcing an Apply AI strategy and a European robotics strategy.

title_original: Apply AI Strategy COM(2025) 723
title_en: Apply AI Strategy (COM(2025) 723)
notes: Sectoral AI adoption flagships incl. advanced manufacturing/robotics, mobility (automated driving testbeds), healthcare and defence; links to planned EU robotics strategy.

title_original: Commission Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence practices established by Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) C(2025) 884
title_en: Commission Guidelines on prohibited AI practices under the AI Act (C(2025) 884)
notes: Interprets Art. 5 AI Act bans (manipulative AI, emotion recognition, real-time remote biometric ID incl. on robots/drones used by law enforcement, social scoring); non-binding.

title_original: Commission Guidelines on the definition of an artificial intelligence system established by Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) C(2025) 924
title_en: Commission Guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the AI Act
notes: Clarifies the seven elements of the AI-system definition (machine-based, autonomy, inference, physical/virtual environment influence); relevant to classifying robot control software.

title_original: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
title_en: General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (AI Act Art. 56)
notes: Voluntary code (transparency, copyright, safety and security chapters) for providers of general-purpose AI models incl. foundation models used in embodied/robot systems; adequacy confirmed Aug 2025.

title_original: Liability for Artificial Intelligence and other emerging digital technologies – Report from the Expert Group on Liability and New Technologies, New Technologies Formation
title_en: Expert Group report on liability for AI and other emerging digital technologies (2019)
issuer: European Commission Expert Group on Liability and New Technologies
notes: Recommends strict liability for operators of high-risk autonomous technologies in public spaces (drones, AVs), compulsory insurance, logging duties; rejects legal personality for robots.

title_original: Ethics of Connected and Automated Vehicles: Recommendations on road safety, privacy, fairness, explainability and responsibility
title_en: Ethics of Connected and Automated Vehicles (Commission Expert Group report)
issuer: European Commission Independent Expert Group on Ethics of CAVs
notes: 20 recommendations for manufacturers, policymakers and researchers on CAV ethics: road safety, dilemma situations, privacy, fairness, explainability and responsibility.

title_original: Guidelines on the exemption procedure for the EU approval of automated vehicles
title_en: Commission Guidelines on the exemption procedure for EU approval of automated vehicles (2019)
issuer: European Commission (DG GROW) / Technical Committee Motor Vehicles
notes: Harmonised national ad-hoc safety assessment and mutual recognition for Level 3/4 vehicles approved via the new-technology exemption (Art. 20 Dir 2007/46 / Art. 39 Reg 2018/858).

title_original: Guide to application of the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC (Edition 2.3)
title_en: Commission Guide to application of the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC
source_database: web (single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu verified; guide PDF via docsroom 60145)
notes: Official interpretative guide (partly completed machinery, robots as machinery, safety components); linked from the Commission machinery sector page.

title_original: EASA Artificial Intelligence Roadmap 2.0 – A human-centric approach to AI in aviation
title_en: EASA Artificial Intelligence Roadmap 2.0
notes: Agency roadmap for certifying AI/ML in aviation incl. autonomous drones: levels of AI (assistance to full autonomy), trustworthiness building blocks, rulemaking RMT.0742.

title_original: EASA Artificial Intelligence Concept Paper Issue 2 – Guidance for Level 1 & 2 machine-learning applications
title_en: EASA AI Concept Paper Issue 2: Guidance for Level 1 & 2 machine-learning applications
notes: Objectives for learning assurance, explainability, human-AI teaming and ethics-based assessment, anticipating certification of autonomous (Level 3) operations incl. UAS.

title_original: Easy Access Rules for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (Regulations (EU) 2019/947 and 2019/945)
title_en: EASA Easy Access Rules for Unmanned Aircraft Systems
notes: Consolidated drone regulations with EASA Acceptable Means of Compliance and Guidance Material (SORA, standard scenarios, PDRA); revision June 2026.

title_original: Commission Implementing Decision C(2023) 3215 on a standardisation request to CEN and CENELEC in support of Union policy on artificial intelligence (M/593)
title_en: Standardisation request M/593 on artificial intelligence (C(2023) 3215)
notes: Requests harmonised standards for AI Act high-risk requirements (risk management, data, logging, human oversight, robustness); amended by C(2025) 3871 (M/613), deadline extended.

title_original: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 'Artificial Intelligence' work programme
title_en: CEN-CENELEC JTC 21 Artificial Intelligence standardisation work programme
notes: European harmonised standards under M/593 (AI trustworthiness framework, risk management, QMS, conformity assessment) intended to give presumption of conformity under the AI Act.

title_original: SPARC – the Partnership for Robotics in Europe (contractual Public-Private Partnership 2014-2020)
title_en: SPARC Robotics Public-Private Partnership (Commission – euRobotics)
source_database: web (eu-robotics.net and EC robotics policy page verified)
notes: EUR 700m Horizon 2020 robotics PPP with Strategic Research Agenda and Multi-Annual Roadmap; succeeded by the AI, Data and Robotics Partnership (ADRA) under Horizon Europe.

title_original: How to integrate thousands of humanoid robots in the near future in industry and in our daily lives (EESC own-initiative opinion CCMI/262)
title_en: EESC opinion on integrating humanoid robots in industry and daily life
notes: Advisory opinion calling for an EU humanoid robotics strategy, safety/liability clarity, worker protection and social dialogue on humanoid deployment.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission on a framework of ethical aspects of artificial intelligence, robotics and related technologies (2020/2012(INL))
title_en: EP resolution on a framework of ethical aspects of AI, robotics and related technologies (2020)
notes: Legislative-initiative resolution with draft regulation on ethical principles for high-risk AI, robotics and related technologies (human oversight, safety, non-bias, remedies).

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission on a civil liability regime for artificial intelligence (2020/2014(INL))
title_en: EP resolution on a civil liability regime for artificial intelligence (2020)
notes: Proposes strict liability with compulsory insurance for operators of high-risk AI systems (listed in an annex, e.g. autonomous vehicles, drones, robots) and fault-based liability otherwise.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 on intellectual property rights for the development of artificial intelligence technologies (2020/2015(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on intellectual property rights for the development of AI technologies (2020)
notes: Position on IP for AI-generated creations and AI/robotics innovations; rejects legal personality for AI; part of the 2020 EP AI package with ethics and liability resolutions.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 6 October 2021 on artificial intelligence in criminal law and its use by the police and judicial authorities in criminal matters (2020/2016(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on AI in criminal law and its use by police and judicial authorities (2021)
notes: Calls for moratorium on facial recognition in public spaces, bans on predictive policing and autonomous police systems; human-in-command for law-enforcement AI incl. drones/robots.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 12 September 2018 on autonomous weapon systems (2018/2752(RSP))
title_en: EP resolution on autonomous weapon systems (2018)
notes: Calls for an EU common position and international ban on lethal autonomous weapon systems without meaningful human control; excludes LAWS from European Defence Fund funding.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 20 January 2021 on artificial intelligence: questions of interpretation and application of international law in so far as the EU is affected in the areas of civil and military uses and of state authority outside the scope of criminal justice (2020/2013(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on AI and international law in civil and military uses (2021)
notes: Positions on military AI and LAWS (meaningful human control), AI in healthcare, transport (automated vehicles) and public authority; calls for international legal framework.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 3 May 2022 on artificial intelligence in a digital age (2020/2266(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on artificial intelligence in a digital age (AIDA report, 2022)
notes: AIDA special committee roadmap: EU AI competitiveness, robotics and automated mobility, health AI, military AI governance; recommendations for the AI Act negotiations.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 15 January 2019 on autonomous driving in European transport (2018/2089(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on autonomous driving in European transport (2019)
notes: Supports Commission automated mobility strategy; calls for EU rules on AV approval, liability, data recorders, cybersecurity, ethics; covers road, rail, waterborne and aviation automation.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 12 February 2019 on a comprehensive European industrial policy on artificial intelligence and robotics (2018/2088(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on a comprehensive European industrial policy on AI and robotics (2019)
notes: Calls for an EU industrial policy on AI and robotics, update of the Machinery Directive and product liability rules, ethics-by-design and skills for robotisation.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 27 February 2014 on the use of armed drones (2014/2567(RSP))
title_en: EP resolution on the use of armed drones (2014)
notes: Calls for an EU common position on armed drones, transparency on targeted killings and a ban on development of fully autonomous weapons enabling strikes without human intervention.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 29 October 2015 on safe use of remotely piloted aircraft systems (RPAS), commonly known as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), in the field of civil aviation (2014/2243(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on safe use of remotely piloted aircraft systems (drones) in civil aviation (2015)
notes: Calls for a risk-based EU drone framework (operation-centric categories, registration, geofencing, privacy), realised in Reg 2018/1139 and Regs 2019/945-947.

title_original: European Parliament resolution of 13 March 2018 on a European strategy on Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems (2017/2067(INI))
title_en: EP resolution on a European strategy on Cooperative ITS (2018)
notes: Supports C-ITS deployment as a step to connected and automated driving; calls for data protection, cybersecurity, hybrid communication and a legal framework for automated vehicles.

title_original: Automated Vehicles Act 2024 (c. 10)
title_en: Automated Vehicles Act 2024
notes: Self-driving framework: authorisation of automated vehicles, authorised self-driving entity and no-user-in-charge operator licensing, user-in-charge immunity, marketing restrictions, APS permits.

title_original: Automated and Electric Vehicles Act 2018 (c. 18)
title_en: Automated and Electric Vehicles Act 2018
notes: Part 1 extends compulsory motor insurance to accidents caused by listed automated vehicles driving themselves; insurer liability with recourse against manufacturers.

title_original: The Automated Vehicles (Permits for Automated Passenger Services) Regulations 2026 (SI 2026/439)
title_en: Automated Vehicles (Permits for Automated Passenger Services) Regulations 2026
notes: Implements the Automated Vehicles Act 2024 permitting scheme for robotaxi/automated passenger services (permit conditions, consent of local authorities, accessibility reporting).

title_original: The Automated Vehicles (Marketing Restrictions) Regulations 2026 (SI 2026/733)
title_en: Automated Vehicles (Marketing Restrictions) Regulations 2026
notes: Protects terms such as 'self-driving' so only authorised automated vehicles can be marketed with them (AV Act 2024 ss. 78-81); follows 2025 consultation on protecting marketing terms.

title_original: Automated vehicles: statement of safety principles (call for evidence 2025 and consultation on draft statutory statement 2026)
title_en: Automated vehicles: statement of safety principles (draft statutory statement under AV Act 2024 s.2)
issuer: Department for Transport / Centre for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
notes: Draft statutory Statement of Safety Principles against which self-driving vehicles will be authorised (safety at least as good as careful and competent human drivers); consultation opened 17 Jun 2026.

title_original: Automated vehicles: protecting marketing terms (consultation and outcome)
title_en: Automated vehicles: protecting marketing terms consultation
notes: Consultation (Jun 2025) and outcome on secondary legislation restricting misleading marketing of driver assistance as self-driving; led to SI 2026/733.

title_original: Automated passenger services (APS) permitting scheme consultation and government response
title_en: Automated passenger services permitting scheme consultation
notes: Consultation (Jul 2025) on the permit scheme for taxi-, private-hire- and bus-like services without a driver; government response April 2026 preceded SI 2026/439.

title_original: Automated passenger service permits: local authority and transport body roles
title_en: Automated passenger service permits: guidance on local authority and transport body roles
notes: Guidance on consent and consultation roles of licensing and transport authorities for robotaxi/automated bus permits under the AV Act 2024.

title_original: Self-driving vehicle pilot scheme: information for applicants
title_en: Self-driving vehicle pilot scheme: information for applicants
notes: Guidance for companies seeking to pilot driverless passenger services from spring 2026 ahead of full AV Act implementation (safety case, permits, insurance expectations).

title_original: Self-driving vehicles: new safety ambition (consultation and government response)
title_en: Self-driving vehicles: new safety ambition consultation
notes: Consultation on the safety ambition that self-driving vehicles should be at least as safe as competent and careful human drivers, feeding the statutory safety principles.

title_original: Automated Vehicles: joint report (Law Com No 404 / Scot Law Com No 258)
title_en: Law Commission and Scottish Law Commission joint report on Automated Vehicles (2022)
issuer: Law Commission of England and Wales / Scottish Law Commission
notes: Three-year review recommending the Automated Vehicles Act model: authorisation, ASDE/NUIC operator duties, user-in-charge immunity, in-use regulator, marketing controls; basis of the 2024 Act.

title_original: Remote Driving: advice to Government
title_en: Law Commission advice to Government on remote driving (2023)
issuer: Law Commission of England and Wales
notes: Advice on remotely driven vehicles (beyond line-of-sight teleoperation): recommends licensing of remote-driving entities and interim use of vehicle special orders.

title_original: Code of Practice: Automated vehicle trialling (Trialling automated vehicle technologies in public)
title_en: Code of Practice: Automated vehicle trialling (CCAV)
issuer: Centre for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles (Department for Transport)
notes: Expectations for public-road AV trials (safety driver/operator, safety case, data recording, engagement); first issued 2015, revised 2019 and 2022 incl. authorisations/exemptions for complex trials.

title_original: Connected and automated mobility 2025: realising the benefits of self-driving vehicles
title_en: Connected and Automated Mobility 2025 (UK policy paper)
issuer: Department for Transport / Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy
notes: UK roadmap committing to a legal framework by 2025, GBP 100m funding, safety ambition and commercial deployment pathway for self-driving vehicles.

title_original: The Pathway to Driverless Cars: A detailed review of regulations for automated vehicle technologies
title_en: The Pathway to Driverless Cars: regulatory review (2015)
notes: Review concluding UK law permitted AV testing with a responsible driver; action plan leading to the 2015 testing code of practice and later legislation.

title_original: Rules on the safe use of automated vehicles on GB roads / The Highway Code amendment (self-driving vehicles) 2022
title_en: Highway Code amendment on self-driving vehicles (2022) and safe-use rules consultation
notes: New Highway Code section on self-driving vehicles (driver may divert attention while vehicle drives itself but must be ready to resume) following 2021 consultation and ALKS listing.

title_original: Safe use of Automated Lane Keeping System on GB motorways: call for evidence and government response
title_en: Safe use of Automated Lane Keeping System (ALKS) on GB motorways: call for evidence
notes: Call for evidence (Aug 2020) and response (Apr 2021) on treating UN R157 ALKS vehicles as automated under AEVA 2018 and amending the Highway Code.

title_original: The key principles of vehicle cyber security for connected and automated vehicles
title_en: Principles of cyber security for connected and automated vehicles (2017)
notes: Eight principles for automotive sector cyber security across the supply chain (board ownership, defence in depth, lifetime security), later basis of PAS 1885.

title_original: The Air Navigation Order 2016 (SI 2016/765)
title_en: Air Navigation Order 2016
issuer: Secretary of State for Transport (under Civil Aviation Act 1982)
notes: Core UK aviation rules incl. small unmanned aircraft provisions (arts 94-95, 265), amended 2018 (400 ft limit, airport restrictions) and 2019 (registration and competency).

title_original: Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021 (c. 12)
title_en: Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021
notes: Part 3 gives police powers to stop, search and seize drones, require landing and issue fixed penalties for unmanned aircraft offences.

title_original: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 (assimilated/retained UK law)
title_en: Assimilated Regulation (EU) 2019/947 on unmanned aircraft operations (UK)
issuer: UK Civil Aviation Authority / Department for Transport (retained EU law)
notes: EU drone operations regulation retained in UK law from 31 Dec 2020 and amended domestically (open/specific/certified categories, UK-specific class marks delayed).

title_original: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 (assimilated/retained UK law)
title_en: Assimilated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems (UK)
issuer: UK Civil Aviation Authority / Department for Transport (retained EU law)
notes: UK version of the EU drone product-requirements regulation (class marks, remote ID) retained after Brexit and amended by UK regulations.

title_original: CAP 722: Unmanned Aircraft System Operations in UK Airspace – Guidance
title_en: CAP 722 Unmanned Aircraft System Operations in UK Airspace (CAA guidance)
notes: Primary CAA guidance on UAS regulation, operational authorisations, operating safety cases (CAP 722A), BVLOS and detect-and-avoid; regularly re-issued.

title_original: The Drone and Model Aircraft Code
title_en: The Drone and Model Aircraft Code (CAA)
notes: Plain-language code summarising legal requirements for recreational and open-category drone flying (registration, flyer ID, height and distance limits).

title_original: Future of Flight action plan
title_en: Future of Flight action plan (2024)
issuer: Department for Transport / Civil Aviation Authority / Future of Flight Industry Group
notes: Joint plan to enable routine drone BVLOS operations by 2027, eVTOL services, UTM/detect-and-avoid standards and regulatory reform.

title_original: Taking flight: the future of drones in the UK – consultation and government response
title_en: Taking Flight: the future of drones in the UK (consultation 2018, government response 2019)
notes: Consultation outcome introducing police powers, extended airport restriction zones, registration and competency testing that fed into the ATMUA Act 2021 and ANO amendments.

title_original: Drone legislation: use, restrictions and enforcement (consultation)
title_en: Drone legislation: use, restrictions and enforcement consultation
notes: Consultation on drone restriction zones, police enforcement powers and counter-drone measures preceding the 2019 government response and ATMUA Act 2021.

title_original: Product Regulation and Metrology Act 2025 (c. 20)
title_en: Product Regulation and Metrology Act 2025
notes: Framework powers to update UK product safety law for new technologies (AI-enabled and connected products), online marketplaces and alignment with EU product rules such as the Machinery Regulation.

title_original: The Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 (SI 2008/1597)
title_en: Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008
notes: UK transposition of Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC (UKCA marking, essential health and safety requirements) governing industrial and service robots placed on the GB market.

title_original: Software and AI as a Medical Device Change Programme
title_en: MHRA Software and AI as a Medical Device Change Programme (roadmap)
issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)
notes: Reform roadmap (2021, updated 2023) for regulating software and AI in medical devices incl. adaptive algorithms, predetermined change control plans and cybersecurity.

title_original: AI Airlock: a regulatory sandbox for AI enabled Medical Devices
title_en: MHRA AI Airlock regulatory sandbox for AI-enabled medical devices
issuer: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA)
notes: Regulatory sandbox programme (phases 1-3, 2024-2026) testing evidence and approval approaches for AI medical devices, including autonomous/adaptive systems.

title_original: BS 8611:2016 Robots and robotic devices – Guide to the ethical design and application of robots and robotic systems
title_en: BS 8611:2016 Guide to the ethical design and application of robots and robotic systems
notes: First published standard on robot ethics: identifies ethical hazards (deception, dependency, privacy, dehumanisation) and gives design and risk-assessment guidance.

title_original: PAS 1881:2022 Assuring the operational safety of automated vehicles – Specification
title_en: PAS 1881:2022 Assuring the operational safety of automated vehicles
notes: Specifies minimum safety case requirements for AV trials and deployments (ODD, safety operators, cybersecurity, incident management); part of the CAV Standards Programme.

title_original: PAS 1883:2020 Operational Design Domain (ODD) taxonomy for an automated driving system (ADS) – Specification
title_en: PAS 1883:2020 Operational Design Domain taxonomy for an automated driving system
notes: Taxonomy of scenery, environmental and dynamic-element attributes for defining ADS operational design domains; precursor to ISO 34503.

title_original: PAS 1882:2021 Data collection and management for automated vehicle trials for the purpose of incident investigation – Specification
title_en: PAS 1882:2021 Data collection and management for automated vehicle trials (incident investigation)
notes: Minimum data to be recorded (vehicle state, ADS status, driver inputs) and retention requirements during AV trials to support incident investigation.

title_original: PAS 1884:2021 Safety operators in automated vehicle testing and trialling – Guide
title_en: PAS 1884:2021 Safety operators in automated vehicle testing and trialling
notes: Guidance on selection, training, competence and working conditions (fatigue, monitoring) of in-vehicle and remote safety operators for AV trials.

title_original: PAS 1885:2018 The fundamental principles of automotive cyber security – Specification
title_en: PAS 1885:2018 The fundamental principles of automotive cyber security
issuer: British Standards Institution (BSI) / Department for Transport
notes: Translates the DfT/CPNI CAV cyber-security principles into specification requirements for organisations across the connected/automated vehicle lifecycle.

title_original: JSP 936 Dependable Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Defence – Part 1: Directive
title_en: JSP 936 Dependable Artificial Intelligence in Defence (Part 1: Directive)
notes: Mandatory MOD policy directive for assuring AI-enabled systems (incl. autonomous platforms and weapons) across the lifecycle: ethics, safety cases, human control, data; published Nov 2024.

title_original: Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy
title_en: UK Defence Artificial Intelligence Strategy (2022)
notes: Strategy for AI-ready Defence incl. autonomous and uncrewed systems, Defence AI Centre, and commitment to meaningful human control of weapons.

title_original: Ambitious, safe, responsible: our approach to the delivery of AI-enabled capability in Defence
title_en: Ambitious, safe, responsible: UK MOD approach to AI-enabled capability in Defence (ethical principles)
notes: MOD AI ethical principles (human-centricity, responsibility, understanding, bias/harm mitigation, reliability) and the UK position on lethal autonomous weapons (context-appropriate human involvement).

title_original: Joint Concept Note 1/18: Human-Machine Teaming
title_en: Joint Concept Note 1/18 Human-Machine Teaming (MOD doctrine)
issuer: Ministry of Defence (Development, Concepts and Doctrine Centre)
notes: Doctrine on integrating robotics, autonomy and AI with human forces; defines automation vs autonomy and sets expectations for human control of AI-enabled systems.

title_original: Joint Doctrine Publication 0-30.2: Unmanned Aircraft Systems
title_en: Joint Doctrine Publication 0-30.2 Unmanned Aircraft Systems (withdrawn)
issuer: Ministry of Defence (Development, Concepts and Doctrine Centre)
notes: Doctrine defining automated vs autonomous systems and the UK position that it does not possess and will not develop fully autonomous weapons; marked withdrawn on gov.uk.

title_original: Proceed with Caution: Artificial Intelligence in Weapon Systems (HL Paper 16, Session 2023-24)
title_en: House of Lords AI in Weapon Systems Committee report: Proceed with Caution (2023)
issuer: House of Lords AI in Weapon Systems Committee
source_database: UK Parliament committees API (publication id 42387 verified)
notes: Recommends an operational definition of AWS, parliamentary oversight, human control over nuclear command and support for an international instrument on LAWS.

title_original: Government response to the House of Lords AI in Weapon Systems Committee Report
title_en: Government response to the House of Lords AI in Weapon Systems Committee report (2024)
notes: Sets out UK policy responses on autonomous weapons definitions, context-appropriate human involvement, CCW engagement and MOD AI assurance.

title_original: Self-driving vehicles – Seventh Report of Session 2022-23 (HC 519)
title_en: House of Commons Transport Committee report on self-driving vehicles (2023)
source_database: UK Parliament committees API (publication id 41454 verified)
notes: Recommends prompt AV legislation, safety standard at least as safe as competent human driver, data sharing, workforce transition; government response HC 264 (Nov 2023).

title_original: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles: The future? (HL Paper 115, Session 2016-17)
title_en: House of Lords Science and Technology Committee report: Connected and Autonomous Vehicles: The future? (2017)
issuer: House of Lords Science and Technology Committee
source_database: UK Parliament committees API (publication id 14382 verified)
notes: Early parliamentary inquiry urging wider focus beyond cars, cross-government strategy, CAV research and a regulatory and liability review.

title_original: Robotics and artificial intelligence – Fifth Report of Session 2016-17 (HC 145)
title_en: House of Commons Science and Technology Committee report: Robotics and artificial intelligence (2016)
issuer: House of Commons Science and Technology Committee
source_database: UK Parliament committees API (publication id 13531 verified)
notes: Recommended a standing Commission on AI, a RAS leadership council and government strategy on robotics and autonomous systems; government response HC 896 (2017).

title_original: MGN 664 (M+F) Amendment 1: Certification process for vessels using innovative technology
title_en: MGN 664 (M+F) Amendment 1 Certification process for vessels using innovative technology (incl. autonomous vessels)
notes: Sets the MCA certification route (equivalence/alternative design) for novel vessels incl. autonomous and remotely operated ships under UK flag.

title_original: MGN 702 (M) Amendment 2: Maritime autonomous surface ships of less than 2.5 metres in LOA
title_en: MGN 702 (M) Amendment 2 Maritime autonomous surface ships of less than 2.5 m length overall
notes: Marine Guidance Note setting safety expectations for very small maritime autonomous surface ships (MASS) operating in UK waters.

title_original: MGN 705 (M) Amendment 1: Remotely operated unmanned vessels (ROUVs) of 2.5 metres to less than 4.5 metres in length overall
title_en: MGN 705 (M) Amendment 1 Remotely operated unmanned vessels of 2.5 m to under 4.5 m
notes: Guidance on design, construction, equipment and operation of small remotely operated unmanned vessels outside the Workboat Code.

title_original: MGN 703: Information concerning the training and competence of Remote Operators working with Remotely Operated Unmanned Vessels (ROUVs), certified under the Workboat Code Edition 3
title_en: MGN 703 Training and competence of remote operators of remotely operated unmanned vessels
notes: Competence and training expectations for remote operators of ROUVs certified under the Workboat Code Edition 3 (Annex 2 remotely operated vessels).

title_original: The Workboat Code Edition 3 (Merchant Shipping (Small Workboats and Pilot Boats) Regulations 2023)
title_en: The Workboat Code Edition 3 (incl. remotely operated unmanned vessels)
notes: Statutory code for small workboats under 24 m given force by the 2023 Regulations; contains the first UK certification requirements for remotely operated unmanned vessels (ROUVs).

title_original: Maritime Autonomous Ship Systems (MASS) – UK Industry Conduct Principles and Code of Practice (Version 7)
title_en: Maritime UK Industry Code of Practice for Maritime Autonomous Ship Systems (v7)
issuer: Maritime UK (industry body, endorsed by MCA)
notes: Industry code (first 2017, v7 Nov 2023) on design, construction, operation, levels of control and remote operator skills for autonomous vessels; referenced by MCA guidance.

title_original: A CAV Roadmap for Scotland
title_en: A Connected and Autonomous Vehicles Roadmap for Scotland (2019)
notes: Scottish Government roadmap for CAV trials (e.g. CAVForth autonomous bus), regulatory engagement, infrastructure and skills.

title_original: Road Traffic and Roads Act 2023 (No. 16 of 2023)
title_en: Road Traffic and Roads Act 2023 (Ireland) – automated vehicle provisions
notes: Section 5 amends the Road Traffic Act 1961 to define automated vehicles and allow regulations for their testing and use; AV provisions commenced 16 Mar 2026.

title_original: S.I. No. 63/2026 – Road Traffic and Roads Act 2023 (Commencement) Order 2026
title_en: Road Traffic and Roads Act 2023 (Commencement) Order 2026 (automated vehicle provisions)
issuer: Minister of State at the Department of Transport
notes: Commences section 5(a)(i)-(ii) of the 2023 Act on 16 March 2026 to enable future testing and deployment of autonomous vehicles on Irish roads.

title_original: S.I. No. 563/2015 – Irish Aviation Authority (Small Unmanned Aircraft (Drones) and Rockets) Order, 2015
title_en: Irish Aviation Authority (Small Unmanned Aircraft (Drones) and Rockets) Order 2015
notes: First Irish drone rules: mandatory registration of drones over 1 kg, operating limits and permissions; superseded by EU Regs 2019/947-945 applicable from 31 Dec 2020.

title_original: Förordning (2017:309) om försöksverksamhet med automatiserade fordon (tidigare: med självkörande fordon)
title_en: Ordinance (2017:309) on trials with automated vehicles (Sweden)
notes: Permit regime administered by Transportstyrelsen for trials of self-driving vehicles on public roads; permit holder responsible; basis for Swedish AV and delivery-robot pilots.

title_original: SOU 2016:28 Vägen till självkörande fordon – försöksverksamhet
title_en: SOU 2016:28 The road to self-driving vehicles – trial operations (interim report)
issuer: Utredningen om självkörande fordon på väg (Government inquiry)
notes: Interim inquiry report proposing the trial-permit law for self-driving vehicles enacted as Ordinance 2017:309.

title_original: SOU 2018:16 Vägen till självkörande fordon – introduktion
title_en: SOU 2018:16 The road to self-driving vehicles – introduction (final report)
issuer: Utredningen om självkörande fordon på väg (Government inquiry)
notes: Final inquiry report proposing a law on automated road traffic (owner/operator responsibility, driver duties, data, criminal liability) for market introduction of automated vehicles.

title_original: Ds 2021:28 Ansvarsfrågan vid automatiserad körning samt nya regler i syfte att främja en ökad användning av geostaket
title_en: Ds 2021:28 Liability in automated driving and new rules to promote geofencing (ministry memorandum)
notes: Ministry memorandum with draft legislation on who is responsible when a vehicle drives in automated mode and on geofencing; follow-up to SOU 2018:16.

title_original: Utredningsuppdrag: Trafikregleringsmodell för användning av automatiserade fordon
title_en: Transportstyrelsen report: Traffic regulation model for the use of automated vehicles (2025)
notes: Agency inquiry (Nov 2025) noting Sweden lacks national legislation for automated/fully automated vehicles and proposing a regulatory model ahead of EU type-approved Level 4 vehicles.

title_original: Inriktning för en svensk regelmodell för automatiserad körning
title_en: Direction for a Swedish regulatory model for automated driving (RISE/VTI report for Transportstyrelsen)
notes: 2026 report analysing SOU 2018:16, Ds 2021:28, the 2023 memorandum and foreign models to propose a Swedish rulebook for unlimited-series automated vehicles from 2027.

title_original: Tieliikennelaki (729/2018)
title_en: Road Traffic Act 729/2018 (Finland)
notes: Technology-neutral road traffic code drafted to accommodate automated driving (driver obligations expressed so automation can perform driving tasks; trials via test plates).

title_original: Ilmailulaki (864/2014)
title_en: Aviation Act 864/2014 (Finland)
notes: National aviation act incl. provisions on unmanned aircraft and remote pilots (operator registration, state aviation, restricted zones) complementing EU Regs 2019/947-945.

title_original: Lov om utprøving av selvkjørende kjøretøy (LOV-2017-12-15-112)
title_en: Act on the testing of self-driving vehicles (Norway)
notes: Permit-based testing of self-driving vehicles with or without a driver; defines responsible party, data obligations and insurance; in force 1 Jan 2018.

title_original: Forskrift om utprøving av selvkjørende motorvogn (FOR-2017-12-19-2240)
title_en: Regulation on the testing of self-driving motor vehicles (Norway)
notes: Implementing regulation under the 2017 Act: application content, risk assessment, permit conditions, reporting; last amended by FOR-2021-03-01-572.

title_original: Forskrift om ubemannede luftfartøyer (BSL A 7-2, FOR-2024-11-01-2777)
title_en: Regulation on unmanned aircraft (Norway, BSL A 7-2)
notes: Implements EU Regs 2019/947 and 2019/945 (EEA) and adds national drone rules (registration, operator requirements, restricted zones); replaced earlier drone regulation.

title_original: Forskrift om luftfartøy som ikke har fører om bord mv. (BSL A 7-1, FOR-2015-11-30-1404)
title_en: Regulation on aircraft without a pilot on board etc. (Norway, 2015)
notes: Norway's original RO1-RO3 drone operator regulation; now applies only to state aviation with unmanned aircraft after EU rules took over civil drones.

title_original: Forskrift om U-space og krav til en integrert digital luftfartspublikasjon for brukere av luftrommet (BSL A 7-3, FOR-2024-10-23-2572)
title_en: Regulation on U-space and an integrated digital aeronautical publication (Norway, BSL A 7-3)
notes: Implements EU U-space Regs 2021/664-666 in Norway for digital drone traffic management airspace.

title_original: RSV 12-2020 Veiledning i forbindelse med bygging eller installering av automatisert funksjonalitet, med hensikt å kunne utføre ubemannet eller delvis ubemannet drift
title_en: Norwegian Maritime Authority circular RSV 12-2020: Guidance on automated functionality for unmanned or partially unmanned operation (autonomous vessels)
notes: Documentation and approval principles (CONOPS, risk assessment, alternative design, minimum risk conditions) for autonomous and remotely operated ships, used e.g. for Yara Birkeland.

title_original: Færdselsloven (lovbekendtgørelse nr. 1312 af 26. november 2024) – §§ 92 f-92 h forsøg med selvkørende motorkøretøjer
title_en: Danish Road Traffic Act (consolidated 2024) – provisions on trials with self-driving motor vehicles
notes: Sections 92 f-92 h (inserted by Act of 2017, bill L 120 2016-17) define self-driving vehicles and let the Transport Minister authorise trials; permit holder bears insurance obligation.

title_original: Lov nr. 566 af 27. maj 2025 om ændring af færdselsloven (Revision af forsøgsordninger for selvkørende motorkøretøjer og selvkørende enheder ...)
title_en: Act No. 566 of 27 May 2025 amending the Road Traffic Act (revision of trial schemes for self-driving motor vehicles and self-driving units)
notes: Revises the self-driving trial regime and introduces 'self-driving units' (e.g. delivery robots); Minister may set rules and apply public transport law to service-like trials.

title_original: Bekendtgørelse nr. 925 af 24. juni 2025 om forsøg med selvkørende motorkøretøjer
title_en: Executive Order No. 925 of 24 June 2025 on trials with self-driving motor vehicles (Denmark)
notes: Implementing order under Road Traffic Act s. 92 g: application, assessor requirements, Vejdirektoratet permits, safety and reporting conditions for self-driving vehicle trials.

title_original: Bekendtgørelse nr. 2253 af 29. december 2020 om supplerende bestemmelser til EU-forordning 2019/947 om regler og procedurer for operation af ubemandede luftfartøjer
title_en: Executive Order No. 2253 of 29 Dec 2020 on supplementary provisions to EU Regulation 2019/947 on unmanned aircraft operations (Denmark)
notes: National drone rules supplementing EU Reg 2019/947 under the Aviation Act (ss. 126 b-c): competent authority, registration, zones and penalties.

title_original: Reglugerð nr. 990/2017 um starfrækslu fjarstýrðra loftfara
title_en: Regulation No. 990/2017 on the operation of remotely piloted aircraft (Iceland)
notes: Iceland's first national drone operating rules (registration, altitude and distance limits, insurance); replaced by the EEA implementation of EU Regs 2019/947-945 (Reg. 1360/2024).

title_original: Reglugerð nr. 1360/2024 um starfrækslu ómannaðra loftfara og ómönnuð loftfarskerfi
title_en: Regulation No. 1360/2024 on the operation of unmanned aircraft and unmanned aircraft systems (Iceland; implements EU Regs 2019/947 and 2019/945)
source_database: island.is regulations database (verified); Samgöngustofa drone rules page
notes: Implements the EU drone framework (open/specific/certified categories, operator registration, class marks) in Iceland via the EEA Agreement.
